title: He sang that song
html_source:
Starting the book with a story and a song shows that Stephen will become an Artist as the title of the book exhibits. Story-telling and singing are two of the most artistic activities that occur on Earth, and Stephen has truly been predisposed to the beauty of art at a young age.

Stories can also open a young person’s creativity and sparks imagination as is seen with Stephen throughout the story.
